beats.vo: Let us fix that this month.

beats.overlay: No buffer = debt on every surprise
beats.vo: With no buffer, every surprise becomes credit card debt. That is the trap.

Forget six months of expenses for now, that number scares people into doing nothing. Start with one thousand dollars. Open a separate account so you can't touch it, automate fifty a week, sell three things you don't use, and put any windfall straight in. Most people hit a thousand in eight to twelve weeks.
Once the mini-fund is done, grow it to three months of expenses. But the first grand is what stops the bleeding.

cta.vo: Follow for the full safety-net plan.

caption:
Don't aim for 6 months. Aim for $1,000 first. 🛟

A separate account + $50/week + selling 3 things = your first grand in ~8-12 weeks. That's what stops a surprise from becoming debt.

Save this and start this week.
